heading: Professional Journey
subtitle: Two security roles — vulnerability management, detection engineering and response automation.

positions.title: Cyber Security Intern
achievements: Ran 75–80 vulnerability assessments with Qualys VMDR and Nmap, tracking findings, remediation timelines and audit evidence through to closure.
Standardised EDR agent baselines across 500+ endpoints, cutting configuration variance across the estate.
Built MITRE ATT&CK–aligned detection logic, lifting lateral-movement and process-anomaly detection fidelity by ~20%.
Automated credential revocation and host isolation in Python and PowerShell against firewall and threat-intel APIs, contributing to ~30% lower MTTR.
Supported forensic analysis and containment for a compromised AWS EC2 instance, and hardened FortiGate rules plus SPF, DKIM and DMARC on FortiMail.
positions.summary: Vulnerability management, detection engineering and incident response inside a 15-person security team.

positions.title: Virtual Intern
achievements: Tuned intrusion detection systems and firewall policy, raising threat-identification accuracy by 35%.
Consolidated 10 threat-intelligence APIs into a single interface, halving analysis time.
Scripted security-log analysis that removed roughly 3 hours of manual review per task.
Ran knowledge-transfer sessions on threat detection and incident response for peer teams.
positions.summary: Simulation programme covering detection tuning, threat-intel integration and response automation.
